audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Trundle five of seven stages while every why and spike describes a Nautilus lane and the win rate is 72.73%.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Skill, Nautilus, Nautilus, Nautilus, Nautilus, Nautilus, Skill. Trundle has no dash, and Depth Charge is point-click.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill, Nautilus x5, Skill with ratings flipped to match.

audit.why: Spikes: levels 2-3 short-trade window, level 6 Depth Charge (120/100/80, the same cooldown as Subjugate), first item engage, late Trundle drain-tank.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields claim Trundle cannot answer the hook ('a full lock he can't Pillar out of', 'a hook he cannot Pillar away from', 'lock him through any Pillar'). The opposite is true for Dredge Line. Chomp's auto-reset tell and Frozen Domain's healing amp were also absent, and mid credited Subjugate with stealing AD.
audit.why: Riot text: Dredge Line 'colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it', and Pillar of Ice 'becoming impassable terrain'. A pillar dropped between you turns your engage into a self-pull onto the wall — Trundle is not moved at all. Subjugate steals Health, Armor and Magic Resist (doubled over 4s); it is Chomp that saps attack damage.
audit.corrected: Hook before Pillar of Ice is placed (15-21s), and rely on point-click Depth Charge — no pillar answers that. Chomp is a 3.5s auto reset: the wind-up is the tell. Frozen Domain amplifies all his healing, so fight off the ice and bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Q pull plus passive root plus E slow is a full lock he can't Pillar out of, and your W burn wins the short trade clean.
edits.after: Q pull into passive root and E slow wins the short trade — but a Pillar between you is terrain, and the hook drags you into it.

edits.before: With Q + W + E online your passive-root into Q pull guarantees a hook he cannot Pillar away from, and your W splash burn wins every short trade.
edits.after: With Q + W + E online your Q pull into passive root wins every short trade — hook before Pillar of Ice lands, since terrain drags you onto the wall.

edits.before: Depth Charge is an undodgeable homing lockup — Trundle has no dash or Pillar that breaks a knock-up, so R into your full CC chain is a guaranteed kill or gank.
edits.after: Depth Charge is point-click, so unlike Dredge Line no Pillar of Ice answers it — R into your full CC chain is a guaranteed kill or a free gank setup.

edits.before: Hit Level 6 and use Depth Charge to lock him through any Pillar so your team converts the all-in
edits.after: Hit Level 6 and use point-click Depth Charge, which no Pillar can answer, to convert the all-in

edits.before: Drop E Pillar between you and him to block your Q gap-close and your engage angle
edits.after: Drop Pillar of Ice between you so your hook pulls you into the wall instead

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are your peak. Your W shield and E scale up so you control the wave and zone him off farm, and at 6 Depth Charge is a homing, undodgeable lockup that no Pillar or W speed zone can escape. R into Q-pull, passive root, E slow is a full chain he simply cannot break — that's a kill or a free gank every time it's up. Force the all-in here; do not let him sit back and stack Subjugate AD off your autos.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your peak. Your W shield and E scale up so you control the wave and zone him off farm, and at 6 Depth Charge is a homing, point-click lockup that no Pillar of Ice or Frozen Domain can escape. R into Q-pull, passive root, E slow is a full chain he cannot break — a kill or a free gank every time it is up. Force the all-in here; do not let him farm King's Tribute heals off dying minions.

edits.before: Steals your stats. Respect it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Subjugate is 120/100/80s and steals health, armour and MR. Bait it.

edits.before: That is Trundle's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Frozen Domain boosts his healing from every source — never brawl on the ice.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Subjugate steals health and resists, doubling over 4 seconds.

edits.before: Whiffing hook and walking forward anyway — your kill threat IS the hook; without it you are a slow shield.
edits.after: Chomp is an auto-attack reset on a 3.5s cooldown — his wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: Track Trundle's Subjugate: Steals your stats. Respect it. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is terrain — hook through it and you are dragged onto the wall instead of him.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Respect it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Trundle Subjugate: 120/100/80s — steals health, armour and MR, doubling over 4s. - Pillar of Ice: 15-21s terrain that turns your hook into a self-pull. - Depth Charge: the win condition, kill windows only.

notes: The mirror's biggest finding is now on this side too: Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain and Dredge Line collides with terrain, so a pillar between you answers the hook outright. Depth Charge is unaffected because it is point-click. Also corrected: Subjugate steals health/armour/MR, not attack damage — Chomp is what saps AD.
